town_square.title: Town Square of Spielburg
town_square.desc: A charming medieval square with a marble fountain, timber-framed guild halls, and cobblestone paths.

hotspots.label: ⛲ Marble Fountain
hotspots.desc: Cool mountain spring water. Restores 10 HP.

hotspots.label: 📌 Notice Board
hotspots.desc: Bounty notices posted by the Town Sheriff & Guildmaster Bruno.

hotspots.label: ⚔️ Adventurers Guild Entrance
hotspots.desc: Door leading into the Adventurers Guild Hall.

hotspots.label: 🌲 Road to Mistvale Forest
hotspots.desc: Dirt road heading east into Mistvale Forest.

hotspots.label: 🎯 Dagger Target Board
hotspots.desc: Wooden target board for dagger throwing drills.

forest_path.title: Mistvale Forest Path & Sun Gate
forest_path.desc: A dense sun-dappled forest path. An ancient Rune Sun Gate blocks entry to Whispering Cavern.

hotspots.label: ☀️ Rune Sun Gate (Whispering Cavern)
hotspots.desc: An ancient stone gate bearing glowing sun runes. Blocks entry to Whispering Cavern.

hotspots.label: 🌲 Deep Forest Grove (North Path)
hotspots.desc: Path winding north into Deep Mistvale Wilderness.

hotspots.label: 🌸 Moonflower Herb
hotspots.desc: A rare glowing blue Moonflower growing near the mossy stones.

hotspots.label: 👺 Goblin Spearman (Grid Combat)
hotspots.desc: A patrol of armed goblin spearmen marching in the clearing.

hotspots.label: 🌉 Stone Bridge (Return to Town)
hotspots.desc: Stone bridge leading back to Spielburg Village.
